findings.finding: `--reingest-missing` apply path always runs `put_top_tickers` + `patch_day_frequencies` after ingest with no check that analytics exist or any rows inserted. `ingest_base_analytics_for_market` can return normally with zero inserts (per-ticker API `None`, `"No tickers to insert"`, or all rows skipped) — script still patches, gap stays, exit 0. Recovery can look successful while TO frequencies stay shallow. Evidence: `            await ingest_base_analytics_for_market(conn, date, market=market)`

`track_density` marks cron failed and notifies, but `run_crud_ops` still calls `publish_day` — Postgres can get shallow frequencies same run. Plan says alert-only; not regression, but guard ≠ publish gate. Evidence: `                    if prior < TO_TRACKING_DENSITY_FLOOR:`
